reply.subject: Re: Larkspur pricing
reply.body:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for asking. Larkspur plans start at USD 1,500 a month. It's built for B2B companies with a sales team of five or more people who work in a CRM like HubSpot, Salesforce or Zoho. For two people keeping track of a few clients, it would probably cost more than it's worth to you right now. A simple CRM, such as the free tier many CRM tools offer, is likely a better place to start.

If your team grows, we'd be glad to talk. Just reply to this email when you're ready and we'll pick it up from there.

The Larkspur team

triage.crm_note: Tom (founder of a 6-person design studio with no CRM) asked about pricing so he and his partner can track a few clients. Told him plans start at USD 1,500/month, explained it's not a fit yet, and moved him to nurture.

Confirm the record's 6 employees vs. the 'just me and my partner' in his message; either way he is below 50 employees.
